shots.content: In a quiet café seating area, the person in the mustard-yellow knit sweater and high curly dark hair bun sits at the window-side seat nearest the tall floor plant, setting down a ceramic mug and gesturing animatedly with both hands while recounting a misplaced set of keys. The person in the forest-green corduroy jacket and round wire-rimmed glasses occupies the window-side seat nearest the café counter, tilting forward with an amused grin, while the person in the cobalt-blue button-down shirt and shoulder-length silver hair sits at the short-end seat directly in front of the tall floor plant, resting both forearms against the tabletop and smiling warmly.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the aisle-side corner, looking diagonally across the rectangular table. The full table and all three seats are visible.

shots.content: The person in the mustard-yellow sweater raises both hands to mime frantically digging through a tote bag, laughing aloud. The person in the forest-green jacket leans in closer over the table, chuckling and adjusting wire-rimmed glasses.
shots.viewpoint: Medium close view of the two people in the window-side seats.

shots.content: The person in the mustard-yellow sweater taps index fingers on the wooden table while delivering the conclusion of the story. The person in the forest-green jacket nods in shared amusement, resting a chin against one palm.
shots.viewpoint: Wide view from the counter end, looking along the full table toward the floor plant. Both window-side seats and the plant-end seat are visible.
